A few details before you start

What counts as an active ad account?

An ad account with agent access enabled in an organization project uses one account slot. The allowance is shared across all projects. Disable an account to free its slot without deleting its project or audit history.

Which people count toward the editing-member allowance?

Organization owners, admins, and members with editing access count toward the allowance. Read-only client viewers are free. A person who can edit several projects in the same organization uses one member slot.

Does every plan include MCP access?

Yes. Every plan includes MCP, CLI, REST, and dashboard access across the available providers. Free is read-only. Paid plans include write tools with the same mandatory preview and approval gate.

How does the seven-day trial work?

Your first paid subscription starts a seven-day trial after you add payment details. Returning subscribers can restart without a second trial. Cancel before it ends to avoid the subscription charge. Free requires no card.

How does yearly billing work?

Pay once for the year: Pro €190, Growth €390, or Agency €790. The monthly equivalent is shown with the full annual charge. This saves two monthly payments compared with paying each month.

Does this include ad spend or AI model usage?

Ad spend is paid to your advertising platforms. Your AI assistant subscription or model usage is separate. Adport does not charge a percentage of your ad spend.

What happens to existing subscriptions?

Your subscription keeps its current price until you choose a change in the billing portal. The new account allowances and free read-only viewers apply to the matching plan.
